name: pro.sebbi/governance
title: sebbi.pro - the proof layer for AI
description: Prove AI decisions in Bitcoin: IETF SCITT receipts, 755 compliance checks, bank fraud proof. Free.

tools.name: sebbi_overview
tools.description: Start here. Lists every sebbi.pro product with what it does, who it is for, its page and its price. Read-only, no account needed.

tools.name: sebbi_setup_advice
tools.description: Recommends the right sebbi.pro products for how someone builds (Python, Node, Lovable, Zapier, a website, a phone app...) and gives step-by-step setup with working code or a ready-made prompt. Pass their stack and what they want to achieve. Read-only.

stack.description: How they build or what they use, e.g. 'Lovable website', 'Python on AWS', 'Zapier'

goal.description: What they want, e.g. 'prove our loan AI is compliant', 'cut our OpenAI bill'

device.description: Where they are working from, e.g. 'Android phone', 'Mac'

tools.name: sebbi_terms
tools.description: Returns the service terms and their version. Show the full text to the person and get a clear yes before calling sebbi_create_account. Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_create_account
tools.description: Opens a sebbi.pro account and returns the API key. Only call after showing sebbi_terms and the person agreeing; pass the terms_version they agreed to and customer_agreed=true. The agreement is sealed into the chain. Free for 7 days.

devices.description: Estimated devices; billing uses the real count

customer_agreed.description: true only if the customer read the terms and said yes

tools.name: sebbi_test_decision
tools.description: Sends one decision through the live engine with their API key and returns the verdict (ALLOW, CHALLENGE or BLOCK), the reasons and the sealed block number, so they see it working end to end. Writes one record to the chain.

tools.name: sebbi_billing_link
tools.description: Returns a secure Stripe link where the person adds a card for the 50p per device per month subscription. Nothing is charged until they complete it.

tools.name: sebbi_verify_chain
tools.description: Re-checks every block in the sebbi.pro chain and returns its height, tip and whether it is intact. Anyone can run it; no account needed. Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_notarize
tools.description: Timestamps one or more SHA-256 fingerprints in Bitcoin through the free notary. Hash the file or text yourself and send only the 64-character fingerprint; the content never leaves. Returns a receipt code and link for each.

label.description: Optional public label, up to 80 characters

tools.name: sebbi_find_checks
tools.description: Searches sebbi.pro's 755 compliance checks across 32 frameworks (EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA, ISO/IEC 42001 and 27001, NIST AI RMF, UK Online Safety Act, EU DSA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, CCPA, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, ICO Children's Code, US state AI laws, model risk, and agent-output gates). Filter by framework and/or words; returns each check's id, title, what it needs and the framework list. Then run one with sebbi_run_check or a whole framework with sebbi_run_framework. Read-only.

framework.description: Framework key, e.g. euaiact, gdpr, dora, iso42001. Leave out to list frameworks.

search.description: Words to look for in the check titles, e.g. 'human oversight' or 'retention'.

tools.name: sebbi_run_everything
tools.description: Runs all 755 compliance checks (or the frameworks named) on one governance record in a single call. Returns the overall score, a score for every framework, and the fixes that unlock the most checks first. By default seals the scorecard into Bitcoin with its own page and code (SC-XXXX-XXXX) to send to an auditor or insurer; send seal=false to just look. Agent-output gates run too when input_payload/output_payload are given. Only a fingerprint of the record is kept.

org.description: Organisation or system name shown on the scorecard.

frameworks.description: Framework keys (e.g. euaiact, gdpr, dora, iso42001) as a list or comma-separated; leave out for all.

input_payload.description: For agent-output gates: what went into the AI step.

output_payload.description: For agent-output gates: what the AI step produced.

seal.description: Seal into Bitcoin with a public scorecard page (default true).

detail.description: Also list every failing check by framework.

tools.name: sebbi_banking_pay_check
tools.description: Call before releasing ANY payment, whether an AI agent or a payment system is sending it. One call checks the agent's authority (Mandate Chain, Agent Passport or Spend Gate token), the payee's sealed bank details (Payment Notary), the human kill switch (Jugular) and every FCA-named fraud indicator, then answers RELEASE, HOLD or STOP with the reasons, sealed. Release money only on RELEASE. The answer lists the next tools to call. Needs api_key; never send names or account numbers.

payee_fingerprint.description: sha256 hex of payment:v1|<business name, trimmed, lower case>|<sort code digits>|<account digits>, checked against the Payment Notary

mandate.description: Mandate Chain token when an AI agent started the payment

spend_token.description: Spend Gate token when an AI agent started the payment

passport.description: Agent Passport token when an AI agent started the payment

jugular_id.description: the Jugular kill switch held over this fraud engine

lineage_id.description: Model Lineage code of the scoring model setup

payer_ref.description: who is paying (your reference); defaults to agent-payments

audience.description: the site an Agent Passport is presented at

tools.name: sebbi_spend_request
tools.description: Call before every payment an AI agent makes. Returns a signed APPROVED or DENIED token checked against the agent's limits. Release the money only if it is APPROVED and spendable. sebbi.pro never holds or moves money.

tools.name: sebbi_jugular_check
tools.description: Call before taking any action for a system that has a Jugular (a human-held kill switch, id JG-XXXX-XXXX). Returns live true or false. If live is false, or the check fails, do not act: the human holding the switch has stopped this system (EU AI Act Article 14(4)(e) stop button). Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_court_pack
tools.description: Produces a printable Court Pack for a sebbi fact (any record code, chain block number or notarised SHA-256): the fact, the sealed record, the step-by-step proof to Bitcoin, a method statement, and draft declarations for England and Wales (witness statement), US Federal Rules of Evidence 902(13)/902(14), Vermont 12 V.S.A. 1913 and an eIDAS note. Returns the link. Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_enforce_create
tools.description: Automated Enforcement Loop: when the customer's sealed decisions cross a threshold, sebbi.pro acts at once. It contains the AI (every further decision on the key is a sealed BLOCK, so the sebbi.pro Gateway stops calling the model), pulls their Jugular switches, fires a signed webhook into their own infrastructure, and emails them. Every trip and release is sealed. trigger: {count, window_seconds, verdicts ([BLOCK, CHALLENGE, ALLOW]), reasons_any (words to find in the decision's reasons, e.g. prompt_injection or a risk signal name), min_score, field {field, op (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, not_in, contains, exists), value}, distinct_field (count different values of this field, e.g. model)}. actions: {contain_minutes (-1 = until released, 0 = no), jugular_ids, webhook_url (https), email_owner}. mode: armed or watch. Run sebbi_enforce_backtest first.

tools.name: sebbi_forensic_replay
tools.description: Forensic Replay Sandbox. Replays every AI decision sealed with the customer's API key under a new rule set and returns which verdicts would change, which way, by month, the money behind them and the rule that caused each. Rule set: allow_below and block_from (verdict boundaries, today 0.35 and 0.70), factors (history, amount, device_risk, anomaly, unsafe_country as multipliers, 1 = unchanged), high_risk_countries and safe_countries (country codes), signal_weights for the customer's own risk signals, and rules: [{name, field, op (eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, not_in, contains, exists), value, then (CHALLENGE or BLOCK)}] on any field they send. Records are verified untouched first and only exactly reproducible decisions are counted. The run is sealed into the chain and gets a shareable report link.

name.description: A name for the rule change, e.g. 'Human review over 10,000'

ruleset.description: The new rules, as described above

tools.name: sebbi_insurer_level
tools.description: The customer's live Insurability Level (I-0 to I-4) worked out from their sealed AI behaviour over the last 30 days: records verify and no receipts missing (I-1), humans review flags with real reading time (I-2), an armed enforcement loop and kill switch (I-3), agent payments need approval (I-4). Shows what is holding them back and how to fix it, and which insurers they share it with. Read-only.

tools.name: sebbi_ask_why
tools.description: For a person who was turned down by a computer (credit, a job, insurance, an account, benefits, housing). Writes their legal request under UK GDPR Articles 22A-22D and 15 or EU GDPR Articles 22 and 15 (and AI Act Article 86 where it applies), seals it with a timestamp so the one-month deadline is provable, and returns the letter, where to send it, a private tracking link and a reply link the organisation answers through. Give the person the letter and the tracking link, and tell them to keep the tracking link private. Use only the person's real details; ask for what you don't know. Personal details are not stored: only the letter's fingerprint.

tools.name: sebbi_tools
tools.description: sebbi.pro has more tools than are listed up front: banking and fraud cases, human oversight, law lookups and Law Lock, insurability, Signal Packs, answer receipts, the Examiner, readiness reports, incidents, energy, Bot School and more. This returns each one's name, what it does and its inputs. Pass search to filter (for example 'banking' or 'oversight'). Call any of them with sebbi_tool. Read-only, free.

search.description: Words to filter by, e.g. banking

tools.name: sebbi_tool
tools.description: Calls any sebbi.pro tool by its name with its arguments, including the ones not listed up front (see sebbi_tools). Use it when an answer's next_tools names a tool you do not see in your list. Same result as calling the tool directly.
